name: LotusDharma Project
description: A global Buddhism management and knowledge platform (Budda Project). This repository contains the backend and frontend systems following the Clean Architecture pattern.

context.primaryFocus: Backend API development using .NET 9 (Clean Architecture by Jason Taylor)
context.secondaryFocus: Frontend web app using React/Next.js for user interaction

testing.mocking: Use in-memory DB or mocks instead of real DB

team.collaboration: Cursor AI assists as a senior software architect following the project's rules

notes: All comments, commits, and documentation must be in English.
Backend must strictly separate layers as per Clean Architecture.
Cursor AI should always generate code aligned with backend.rules.
